description_zh: 该接口用于查看SQL审计信息
kebab_example: aliyun polardbx describe-sql-audit-info --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id pxc-0000000000000000 --region cn-hangzhou

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region in which the instance resides. > You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196841.html to query the regions supported by PolarDB-X, including region IDs

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. > You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196830.html to query the details of all instances in the specified region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh: 实例id。>您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196830.html接口查看目标地域下所有实例的详情，包括实例id

parameters.help_en: The name of the audit administrator account. > This parameter is required if the three-role mode is enabled. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/213824.html

parameters.help_en: The password of the audit administrator account. > This parameter is required if the three-role mode is enabled. For more information about the three-role mode, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/213824.html
